record_type_quote: Reported here is a direct replication of that experiment, using the same anagrams, instructions, and colors, with more than triple the number of participants used in the original study.

targets.title: Blue or red? Exploring the effect of color on cognitive task performances.
targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of the experiment reported here was to replicate directly the procedure of one of the Mehta and Zhu (2009) experiments. Their first experiment, concerning the effect of color on anagram solution times, was chosen because the effect sizes were large—Cohen’s d values ranged from 0.81 to 1.1 (Mehta & Zhu, 2009, p. 1227)—and the experiment used a simple design that would be easy to replicate.
targets.outcome_quote: The results failed to confirm the interaction effect and the specific contrasts reported by Mehta and Zhu (2009).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude the central interaction and specific contrasts were not confirmed; the additional Study 3 strategy measure also showed no color effect.

reasoning: Direct new-sample replication of the anagram effect, with additional strategy items from the same original paper. Reference DOI is not printed.
